bluetooth_confirm.description:
Set up {name} ({model})? Home Assistant keeps a permanent Bluetooth connection to the lamp, so the Govee app cannot connect while the integration runs.

H6058 is tested. H6008, H613A, H613D and H6159 are untested: please report what works and what fails as a GitHub issue (Device report).

pick.description: H6058 is tested. H6008, H613A, H613D and H6159 are untested: please report what works and what fails as a GitHub issue (Device report).

manual.description:
Enter the Bluetooth MAC address of the lamp and choose its model. The lamp must be in range of a Bluetooth adapter or an ESPHome Bluetooth proxy with active connections.

H6058 is tested. H6008, H613A, H613D and H6159 are untested: please report what works and what fails as a GitHub issue (Device report).

data_description.address: For example A1:B2:C3:D4:E5:F6. The last four digits are part of the name the lamp advertises, such as Govee_H6058_E5F6.

error.invalid_address: This is not a valid MAC address.

abort.already_in_progress: This lamp is already being set up.
abort.not_supported: This Govee model is not supported.

not_found.message: No connectable Bluetooth adapter or proxy sees the lamp {address} yet.

send_failed.message: Could not send the command to {name} over Bluetooth: {error}
